newsitem.title: BARBADOS: CRICKET-CAMPBELL HITS 97 AS INDIA SUFFER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CAMPBELL HITS 97 AS INDIA SUFFER.

text.p: West Indies opener Sherwin Campbell warmed up for next Thursday's third test by hitting 97 for Barbados in their three day match against India on Sunday.
Campbell's innings helped Barbados build a healthy first innings on a day of suffering for the fielding Indians.
By the close Barbados, who lead the local Red Stripe tournament, were 338 for four in reply to India's first innings total of 210 all out.

Campbell, whose form has deserted him since the middle of the Australia tour earlier this year, faced 186 deliveries and struck 16 fours before offering a bat-pad catch to wicketkeeper Syed Karim off off-spin bowler Noel David.
Campbell and captain Philo wallace shared 135 for the first wicket, before Wallace was bowled by fast medium bowler Abey Kuruvilla for 69 off 110 balls with 12 fours and two sixes.
